label: Revised must-exist and complementary…: A2P2C stipulates that a thing must by nature exist when it…
term: revised must-exist and complementary contingency in A2P2C/A2C3
definition: A2P2C stipulates that a thing must by nature exist when it would automatically exist if its existence were even possible; any other kind of thing is called contingent. The editorial label κ denotes that revised class and its complement only to distinguish this reading. The page then re-asks the uncaused-contingent exclusion under that classification. κ is not a source symbol or a new Lean relation.
note: The would/automatically wording is retained without selecting a counterfactual or material-implication semantics. In particular κ is not defined as a truth-functional possible-existence-implies-existence conditional that could hold vacuously, nor identified with NecessaryAt, ordinary inability not to exist, or the old source contingency class. A2C3 retains stock must-exist/contingent tooltips but expressly appeals to the revised stipulation. No example of an actually existing κ bearer is supplied independently of the disputed argument.
